北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京的朋友们，天晴但体感寒冷，注意保暖，多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's sunny but feels cold. Stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，出行请注意交通安全，添衣防寒，照顾好自己。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy, drive safely! Dress warm and take care.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有霾，出门记得防护，天凉多穿衣，注意身体健康。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has haze, protect yourself when out. It's cool, dress warmly!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗温暖，风力 0级，昼夜温差大，早晚注意添衣。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm. Mind the temperature swing, dress in layers.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗舒适，体感宜人，早晚温差仍存，记得随身带件外套。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant. Still a big day-night difference, bring a jacket!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州天晴，体感 3℃，早晚偏凉，出门别忘添衣，注意防寒。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny, feels like 3℃. Mornings/evenings are cool, dress warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴好，体感 4℃，早晚温差大，记得多添衣，保持暖和。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and pleasant, feels like 4℃. Mind the temperature change, dress warmly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 7℃，温度适中，出门带伞，谨防感冒哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 7℃. Temperature is mild, bring an umbrella and avoid colds.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，风力 0级，能见度低，注意交通，保暖防寒哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy with low visibility. Drive safely and keep warm!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 3℃，空气干燥，记得保暖，注意补水润燥。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 3℃. Air is dry, stay warm and hydrate well.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 8℃，能见度不高，出行注意安全，穿暖和。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, feels like 8℃. Low visibility, travel safely and dress warmly.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感-12℃，穿最厚的衣服，注意防冻保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is freezing! Feels like -12℃, wear your warmest clothes and prevent frostbite!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳严寒，体感-15℃，外出务必多穿衣，小心冻伤哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is bitterly cold, feels like -15℃. Dress in layers, watch out for frostbite!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云风力 3级，体感稍凉，记得添衣，注意防风保湿哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and windy. Feels cool, dress warmly and stay hydrated!
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴好风力 3级，体感 7℃，外出注意防风，早晚记得添衣。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and windy, feels like 7℃. Mind the wind, add clothes morning/evening.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感-2℃，海风阵阵，出门请务必穿暖，注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels like -2℃ with sea breeze. Dress very warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连天晴，体感-5℃，风力 2级，保暖是关键，多穿别着凉。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like -5℃ with wind. Stay warm, dress in layers to avoid colds.
